observations: Original HB190 confirms two left-hand cleats and five fulcrum brackets: these are not new OCR errors. Original HB189 also lists one M4131 under CENTER, while Plate113 labels the center support M1431. The identity/count relationship remains unresolved.
Original SNL63 confirms four left cleats and four rear fulcrum assemblies. SNL170 confirms three half-inch by two-inch rivets per M4130 and two half-inch by two-and-one-eighth-inch rivets per M4131.

SNL6 intact rear side shows a downward-open channel section: horizontal top web with two descending flanges. HB104 photograph shows the upper platform, rear-facing lip, floor cleats and upward pivots. This supports a downward-open stock interpretation; no rolled section size is printed.
Floor bolts and the complete stock-length/grip relationship remain to be reconstructed before the channel can be installed.
selected_rear_configuration: Use the internally consistent SNL four M4131 rear fulcrums and four M4130 plus two M4129 cleats for the next construction hypothesis; preserve HB alternatives and center identity issue.
